about: Risky Rails sound design as data (rr-soundsmith). Hand-edited. Canon numbers are {v, canon} and are checked against rr-bible; asset ids and licences live in assets.json (script-written). Format: references/schema.md.

meta.ref_volume_note: assumed: Sound.Volume 0.5 (Roblox default) plays a file at its measured level; Volume = ref_volume x 10^(gain_db/20). Studio test in references/fidelity.md

ladder.note: effective in-game level per tier (LUFS, momentary max for one-shots, integrated for loops); fail > crisis > commit > reward > UI, loops under all

Music.note: diegetic cab radio only (OQ-021 default A: no music bed in runs)

voices.note: one-shots only; loops are keyed and never stolen. Alarms 6 = the 4 crisis alarms plus 2 impacts; a playing alarm is cut only by the fail or another alarm. 16 is assumed for phones (Studio test)

emitters.lever: the junction lever handle (cab or gantry)
emitters.wheels: the bogie under the player's coach

brief.moment: the boiler explodes (hard fail); the YOU'RE FIRED stamp follows
brief.must_say: total, cartoon disaster: huge but funny, never grim
brief.sounds_like: a big cartoon kaboom, then clattering debris and one last pan-like clang
layers: low boom 30-80 Hz with a mid crack
brief.avoid: war or horror explosions, screams, long ringing tinnitus

brief.moment: COAL LOW! ticket lands
brief.must_say: the fire is dying, go shovel: a sad, droopy call you learn in one trip
brief.sounds_like: a two-note descending brass wah-wah, like a deflating trombone on a klaxon
layers: two descending tones 350-500 Hz with strong 1-3 kHz harmonics
brief.avoid: sirens (pressure owns the rising siren), horror stings

brief.moment: PRESSURE HIGH! ticket lands
brief.must_say: it is about to blow: rising, urgent, kettle-like
brief.sounds_like: a kettle shriek rising into fast beeps, with a steam hiss under it
brief.avoid: air-raid sirens, anything that sounds like the coal alarm

brief.moment: BREAKDOWN! ticket lands (electrics, axle, window or coupling fault)
brief.must_say: something mechanical just broke: grab a wrench
brief.sounds_like: a metal bang with sparks crackling, then two blunt buzzer blasts
brief.avoid: gunshots, glass (windows own glass)

brief.moment: PASSENGERS UPSET! ticket lands
brief.must_say: the passengers are panicking: comic, not scary
brief.sounds_like: a small cartoon crowd going waaah with rising pitch, like a sitcom gasp
layers: 3-6 voices on an open ah vowel
brief.avoid: real screams of pain or fear, children crying, horror

brief.moment: a coach window smashes
brief.must_say: a window just went: where it is matters
brief.sounds_like: a pane shattering with bright shards tinkling down
brief.avoid: long tails, bottle-break cliches

brief.moment: a coupling snaps and a carriage is lost
brief.must_say: we just lost a carriage: a big, final snap
brief.sounds_like: a heavy chain link snapping with a metal twang and a chain rattling away
brief.avoid: gunshot, bone-crack sounds

brief.moment: the puller's knob passes the detent; the bet is locked (lands with the hit-stop)
brief.must_say: heavy, final, mechanical: no going back
brief.sounds_like: an iron lever dropping into a notch; a big latch; a pinball flipper's thunk
brief.avoid: gunshots, long reverb, UI-like clicks

brief.moment: each of the last 3 seconds of the lever countdown (the runtime raises pitch 6% per step)
brief.must_say: decide now: the loudest countdown in the game
brief.sounds_like: a big wooden clock tick crossed with a signal-box bell tap
layers: wood-block knock with a bright 2-3 kHz edge
brief.avoid: bomb-timer beeps, sci-fi blips

brief.moment: JUNCTION AHEAD! ticket lands; the junction lamp starts flashing
brief.must_say: a fork is coming, get to the lever
brief.sounds_like: two crisp signal beeps, like a level-crossing warning
brief.avoid: anything alarm-like; this is information, not danger

brief.moment: RISKY ROUTE! stamp and the YOU'RE FIRED stamp land
brief.must_say: official, comic, final: a rubber stamp hitting a desk
brief.sounds_like: a rubber stamp slammed on paper on a wooden desk
brief.avoid: gavel or gunshot

brief.moment: the crew (not the puller) hears the route lock
brief.must_say: the points just moved: the bet is placed
brief.sounds_like: distant railway points clacking over, two heavy clacks
brief.avoid: sounding like the lever clunk itself

brief.moment: the whistle before departure; the world starts to scroll
brief.must_say: we're off: cheerful, big, steam
brief.sounds_like: a three-chime steam whistle, bright chord with breathy steam
layers: slight scoop up at the start
brief.avoid: diesel horns (alpha is steam only), ship horns

brief.moment: the train stops at the station marker
brief.must_say: we made it: a long exhale
brief.sounds_like: a big steam brake hiss with a low settle
brief.avoid: air-brake squeal of modern trains

brief.moment: FARE BANKED! at a station
brief.must_say: money is safe: a satisfying ka-ching
brief.sounds_like: an old till: drawer slide then a bright bell
brief.avoid: casino jackpots or coin showers (never sell odds)

brief.moment: the supply crate lands on the coach roof
brief.must_say: your crate is up there, go get it
brief.sounds_like: a wooden crate dropping onto a metal roof, with a short creak
brief.avoid: explosions

brief.moment: one shovel load lands in the firebox
brief.must_say: that helped: scrape, throw, the fire answers
brief.sounds_like: a shovel scrape, coal thrown in, a whoomph of fire
brief.avoid: digging in dirt, gravel footsteps

brief.moment: a breakdown task completes (wrench, wire match)
brief.must_say: fixed: clank-clank-ding
brief.sounds_like: two wrench clanks on iron, then a small bell ding
brief.avoid: power-tool whirs

brief.moment: a player presses the cab Horn button
brief.must_say: honk: silly and fun to spam (cooldown stops abuse)
brief.sounds_like: a short two-tone toy horn
brief.avoid: loud modern diesel horns

brief.moment: a GUI button is pressed
brief.must_say: pressed: tiny and dry
brief.sounds_like: a small mechanical switch click
brief.avoid: phone keyboard clicks, anything longer than 100 ms

brief.moment: an info ticket (crew joined or left) lands
brief.must_say: for your information: soft, never urgent
brief.sounds_like: a two-note station chime, very short
brief.avoid: notification sounds of real phone apps

brief.moment: all trip while Speed > 0 (rate and level follow Speed)
brief.must_say: we're moving, and how fast
brief.sounds_like: clickety-clack rail joints over a rolling rumble, recorded at the Normal notch
brief.avoid: modern welded-rail hum, squeals

brief.moment: all trip, near the firebox
brief.must_say: the fire is alive (the cab has a heartbeat)
brief.sounds_like: a steady fire roar with small crackles
brief.avoid: campfire-at-night mood

brief.moment: all trip outdoors (Line 1 grassland)
brief.must_say: open country going by
brief.sounds_like: light wind with gentle gusts
brief.avoid: storms, howling

brief.moment: the cab Radio button toggles a loop
brief.must_say: a crackly, cheerful little station tune
brief.sounds_like: a jaunty old-timey jingle through a tinny radio speaker
brief.avoid: licensed pop songs, anything not owner-made or Roblox-licensed

brief.moment: while a player is in the Depot Lobby (lobby place; stops before the teleport)
brief.must_say: a sleepy, run-down depot where our train is waiting
brief.sounds_like: a resting steam loco breathing slow puffs, an iron lantern buzzing, a few distant birds and a creaking sign
brief.avoid: music (open question lobby-audio, default A: no music), crowd walla, city traffic, night crickets or wind howl (horror-adjacent)

brief.moment: a player steps onto a queue pad (pitched down when they step off)
brief.must_say: you're on the crew for this train
brief.sounds_like: a conductor's ticket punch biting card, chk-chk, with a small brass click
brief.avoid: cash sounds (the till owns money), UI blips, stapler

brief.moment: each of the last 5 s of the queue-pad countdown (the runtime raises pitch 4% per step)
brief.must_say: this train leaves soon: get on the pad
brief.sounds_like: a station platform hand-bell, one ding per second
brief.avoid: the fork countdown tick (the loudest countdown belongs to the lever), school bells, alarm clocks

brief.moment: the queue pad launches (Launching lock on, teleport starts)
brief.must_say: all aboard: we're going
brief.sounds_like: a guard's pea whistle, one long trilled blast, friendlier than a referee
layers: pea whistle 2.5-3.2 kHz with a 25-35 Hz trill
brief.avoid: the steam whistle chord (departure owns it), referee triple blasts, police whistles
